cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the national e-GP system takes tenders. The Central Bank's own e-procurement system, live from October 2025 (SWZ-003), covers its purchasing only.
cells.note: The Finance PS told PAC the e-GP project is implemented while the Auditor General reported E500,000 of E18.8 million spent (SWZ-001, June 2026); the Central Bank's system (SWZ-003) does not carry the country.
